title: Algorithms A, B, and C: actual runtime versus growth trend
summary: Compare the runtime curves of algorithms A, B, and C to distinguish actual elapsed time from asymptotic growth trend.
context: The horizontal axis shows input size n with ticks from 0 to 9; the vertical axis shows algorithm running time with visible ticks at 0, 5, 10, an ellipsis, and 1000000. Because the vertical axis compresses the span between 10 and 1000000, vertical distances between curves are not drawn to a uniform scale.
description: All three algorithms execute the same print operation. In the table below, print counts come from the chapter code, while curve colors and positions come from the figure.

frames.title: Algorithms A, B, and C: actual runtime versus growth trend
frames.explanation: Neither A nor C changes its operation count as n grows, so both belong to O(1) despite their large difference in runtime; B grows linearly with n and belongs to O(n). Extrapolating by print count, B and C intersect at n = 1000000, beyond the horizontal range plotted.
